flagged.evidence: Step 4.1 uses [F2] to approximate arbitrary k in complex L²(R⁶; C) by finite rational-coefficient box steps. The cited supplier states that box indicators with “rational coefficients” are dense in Lᵖ(Rⁿ). These coefficients are real rationals, so the approximants are real-valued: for k = i·1_(0,1]⁶, every such approximant s satisfies ||s−k||₂ ≥ ||Im k||₂ = 1. The cited density therefore does not license the convergence used here. Approximating real and imaginary parts separately, or using coefficients in Q+iQ, closes this short proof gap.
